name: Illustrated Explainer
description: Every scene is drawn in code: diagrams, flows, comparisons, code windows, checklists and icons that draw on, pop and tick in, over a dark blueprint grid. Two-tone headlines, word-pill captions, a live top HUD, sound effects on every beat and a ducked music bed. No emoji, no stock footage. This is a format (look, camera, motion and layout), not a fixed subject: every video brings new subjects.
prompt_hint: Write 8-14 short scenes (one idea each, 3-6 s). Every scene has title.kicker + title.main and visual.type "illustration" with 2-5 elements that literally depict the idea: compare/split for comparisons, flow/timeline for processes, doc/checklist for specs, code/terminal for code, bars/counter for numbers, icon/svg for objects, callout/stamp for emphasis. Use the HUD to track the story state. Never use emoji. Draw new subjects every video: invent the icons, svg sketches and drawing elements for this topic, and never reuse the example spec's scenery, objects or wording.
